title: Lot analyzer ⋯ popover closes immediately on duplicate-name suggestion chips
description:
When vision returns the same card name twice (different sourceImagePosition), the LotAnalyzerModal's per-chip state (openPickerName, pickedCardIdByName, acceptedSuggestionKeys) collides because it's keyed by s.name. Clicking ⋯ on the second chip flips state to 'open' but React reconciles with the first chip as anchor; Radix's outside-click handler then immediately closes it.

Same bug also means accepting one of the duplicate chips flags both, and 'change printing' on the second mutates the first's pick.

Repro: 'Pokémon Cards Collection With Pokémon Binder 80 Cards Mega ex ALL NM+' lot — Mega Latias Ex appears twice; ⋯ on the second chip flickers.

Fix: introduce suggestionKey(s) = name+sourceImagePosition; use it everywhere the modal keys per-chip state.

title: bug: 'Validation error' when saving lot analysis with picked printings
description:
Reported 2026-05-23 by John on https://poke-sniper.up.railway.app/ while testing the new pick-printing feature.

REPRO
1. Open Analyzer modal on lot 'Pokémon TCG Mixed V/VMax/Alt art/Lot of 4– NM'.
2. Run Suggest cards from photos → AI returns 4 chips: Drapion V, Sandaconda V, Rapid Strike Urshifu Vmax, Skuntank V.
3. Accept all 4 (chip body click or ⋯ → Pick correct printing — both paths reach this state).
4. Your additions populates with 4 entries: swsh12pt5gg-GG49, swsh8-252, swsh5-169, and one more clipped off-screen.
5. Click 'Save analysis' → toast appears in bottom-right: 'Validation error'. Save does not succeed.

OBSERVED CARDIDS
- swsh12pt5gg-GG49 — Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery subset (uppercase letters in the number part)
- swsh8-252 — Fusion Strike
- swsh5-169 — Battle Styles

HYPOTHESES (in priority order)

H1 — Schema rejecting one of the cardId formats. annotationUpsertSchema at server/src/routes/lots.ts:235 wraps addedCardSchema (likely zod). If the schema enforces a particular cardId shape (e.g. lowercase only), 'swsh12pt5gg-GG49' would fail because of the GG suffix.

H2 — Server-side existence check rejecting an unknown cardId. routes/lots.ts:290 does prisma.card.findMany on the addedCard ids; if any id isn't in the Card table the handler likely returns 400. The Galarian Gallery subset may not be in the catalog snapshot.

H3 — Generic 'Validation error' toast hides the actual server response. The client's useSaveAnnotation error handler may collapse all 4xx errors to a single string. Check client/src/hooks/useLots.ts for the mutation's onError; either surface the server's message or log the response body so the next repro shows the real reason.

INVESTIGATION PLAN
1. Repro with browser DevTools open → capture the PUT /api/lots/:ebayItemId/annotation response body. That tells us whether it's Zod or the catalog-check that's firing.
2. If Zod: relax the cardId regex (or remove it) — the catalog has canonical sources; we shouldn't be the second line of defense.
3. If catalog: either drop the strict 'all cardIds must exist' check (return summaries with name='(unknown)' the way reValueWithAnnotation already does) or extend the catalog sync to include Galarian Gallery / promo subsets.
4. Improve the client toast to show the server's error message rather than the generic 'Validation error' — this bug took longer to triage than it should have.

REGRESSION RISK
This is a high-priority blocker for the pick-printing feature: the picker works fine but the user can't persist any picks. Until this is fixed, the feature is read-only.

REFERENCES
- server/src/routes/lots.ts: PUT /:ebayItemId/annotation handler at line 284, addedCardSchema at line 235, prisma.card.findMany validation at line 290
- client/src/hooks/useLots.ts: useSaveAnnotation mutation (line 75 area)
- client/src/components/shared/LotAnalyzerModal.tsx: Save button + error toast plumbing

title: Fix client Railway build
description: Client service was using root railway.json (server's build config) and failing on corepack signature verification. Plan: create per-service client/railway.json + set rootDirectory=client + point client service config path at client/railway.json.
close_reason: Fixed client deploy. Root cause: client service was reading the SHARED root /railway.json which contains the server's build/start commands, regardless of railwayConfigFile or rootDirectory overrides on the service. railway up from repo root always includes / railway.json in the build context. Working fix: (1) set buildCommand='npm install --include=dev && npm run build' and startCommand='npx serve -s dist -l $PORT --no-clipboard' directly on the client service via GraphQL serviceInstanceUpdate, (2) deploy with 'railway up ./client --path-as-root --service client' so only the client/ subdir becomes the build context (no stray /railway.json). HTTP 200 confirmed at poke-sniper.up.railway.app.

title: Diagnose & fix Railway build failures
description: Railway builds for the server have been failing. Recent commit 8e034cd was a build fix (prisma move to dependencies). Need to fetch the actual failing build log via Railway CLI/MCP, identify the first error, and apply a targeted fix per the plan at ~/.claude/plans/we-need-to-continue-snoopy-reddy.md
close_reason: Fixed by 6e5866d. Root cause: Railway sets NODE_ENV=production on the server service, so pnpm install skipped devDependencies. Build then failed first on prisma (fixed 8e034cd), then tsc (fixed 8a51aef), then @types/node. Final fix: in railway.json buildCommand, prefix install with NODE_ENV=development and use --force so devDeps are reinstalled over the Nixpacks step-7 prod-only install. Deploy succeeded, server running on port 8080.

title: Surface 'AI temporarily unavailable' when all vision calls fail
description:
When every per-image Anthropic call in runLotVision throws (e.g. credit balance exhausted, rate limit, transient 5xx), the catch block swallows them and the route returns suggestions=[]. The client renders this identically to 'no cards found in photos', giving the user no signal that the AI itself failed.

Repro: drain Anthropic credit, click Suggest cards from photos. Logs show 6× '400 credit balance too low' but UI shows 'No cards identified in the photos.'

Fix sketch:
- runLotVision tracks failedCount alongside processedCount/cachedCount
- VisionRunResult gains failedCount (or a status like 'all-failed' / 'partial-failed')
- POST /api/lots/:ebayItemId/ocr-suggestions returns either 503 with a meaningful message when failedCount === capped.length, or includes a warning field in the JSON
- Client suggestions panel renders a distinct error state ('AI temporarily unavailable — try again later') when warning/status indicates all-failed
- autoOcrLots sweep should also log a single rollup line distinguishing 'all images failed' from 'all images returned 0 cards'

Files:
- server/src/services/lotVisionAi.ts (runLotVision, VisionRunResult)
- server/src/routes/lots.ts (POST /:ebayItemId/ocr-suggestions response)
- client/src/hooks/useLots.ts (handle warning field)
- client/src/components/shared/LotAnalyzerModal.tsx (render error state)
